data.name: Mehnoor
data.gender_notes: Mehnoor is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘an-Nuura’, which means ‘light’. Mehnoor is a name that signifies radiance and illumination, both spiritually and physically. In Islam, it is believed that the light of faith guides individuals to the path of righteousness and salvation. The name Mehnoor carries the meaning “Light, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mehnoor usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner light of faith and guidance in Islam.
data.etymology: Mehnoor belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mehnoor total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mehnoor holds a rich cultural significance in the Islamic world. It is often used for girls, evoking the image of a glowing, radiant, and luminous personality. The very sound of the name elicits feelings of warmth, beauty, and elegance. The idea of light being synonymous with knowledge, wisdom, and enlightenment is deeply embedded in Middle Eastern and Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Mehnoor signifies the light of faith that guides individuals towards a path of righteousness and salvation. It is believed that every human being has a destined journey in life and the light of faith serves as the beacon that steers them towards their true purpose. A person named Mehnoor is seen as someone who not just receives this celestial light but also reflects it in their actions, words, and demeanor. This name is a constant reminder of the spiritual journey that each individual undertakes in their lifetime.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mehnoor is a variant of Mehrnoor, which is derived from the Persian word for "benevolent". The name Mehnoor carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Mehnoor is mentioned in the works of Persian poet Rumi, who wrote about a woman named Mehrnoor in his poem "The Garden of Love".
